metadata.question: Between January 8 and January 15, 2020, did Sistan-Baluchestan experience over 3 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Sistan-Baluchestan province (Iran), approximately 30.9°N, 61.5°E - Date range: January 8-15, 2020 - Data source: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations) - a satellite-based rainfall dataset with good coverage globally - Alternative: MERRA-2 precipitation data if CHIRPS unavailable 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed; precipitation data is already processed - CHIRPS provides daily rainfall estimates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Valid Zero: Region received 0-3 inches of rainfall (Answer B) - Over 3 inches: Answer A - No data available for the region/date: Answer C1 - Calculation failure (NaN, None): Answer C3 4. Conversion: 3 inches = 76.2 mm ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Sistan-Baluchestan region (approximate bounding box) const geometry = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([59.5, 29.5, 63.5, 32.5]); // Date range: January 8-15, 2020 const startDate = '2020-01-08'; const endDate = '2020-01-15'; // Load CHIRPS daily precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geometry); // Check if data exists const imgCount = chirps.size().getInfo(); print(`CHIRPS Images in date range: ${imgCount}`); if (imgCount === 0) { print('No CHIRPS data found for date range.'); print('C1'); return; } // Sum precipitation over the date range (daily CHIRPS values) const totalPrecip = chirps.select('precipitation').sum(); // Calculate mean precipitation over the region (in mm) const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const precipMm = stats.precipitation; print(`Total Precip (mm): ${precipMm !== null ? precipMm.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); // Validate result if (precipMm === null || isNaN(precipMm)) { print('C3'); return; } // Convert to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = precipMm / 25.4; print(`Total Precip (inches): ${precipInches.toFixed(2)}`); // Determine answer if (precipInches > 3) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
